title: Agent community (entity-set view of agent grouping)
description: Per lab/.../entity-set/library/entity/library/agent-community/: a community of agent-entities, distinguished from agentic-system by perspective — agent-community is the entity-set view (a set of agents), agentic-system is the structured-system view (a system containing those agents). Swarm is a specific kind of agent-community AND a specific kind of agentic-system.
